title: Ham & Mozzarella Cottage-Cheese Wrap
summary: A blended cottage-cheese, egg and Parmesan base baked into a thin wrap, then filled with mozzarella, ham, sun-dried tomatoes and rocket. The description supplies the measurements and 180 °C / 20-minute bake; Louis adds unmeasured garlic in his recreation.

ingredients.note: Louis adds garlic at 0:11 and notes that the tutorial did not say garlic. It is not in the description's ingredient list, and no quantity is supplied. Omit when following the written recipe exactly.

steps.text: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, Parmesan and Italian seasoning until smooth. Louis also adds garlic in his recreation; this is an unmeasured addition, not part of the written ingredient list.
Line a baking tray with baking paper. Pour on the mixture and spread it into a thin rectangle; the tray dimensions are not stated.
Bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes, until set. Temperature and time come from the description; the source does not specify fan versus conventional oven.
Add the mozzarella, sun-dried tomatoes, ham and rocket to the baked base. The video adds them in that order; the written method lists mozzarella, ham, sun-dried tomatoes and rocket.
Roll it up and slice in half, as directed in the description. Louis uses the baking paper to help roll and hold it together.
